description: This file contains test code for the GatewayConnection component, including mock implementations of WebSocketTask and WebSocketSession, setup for test instances, and test functions verifying behavior when the process is missing and when sending an empty message.

classes.name: FakeWebSocketTask
classes.description: Mock implementation of WebSocketTasking for testing, simulating WebSocket task behavior and error conditions.

classes.name: FakeWebSocketSession
classes.description: Mock implementation of WebSocketSessioning that provides FakeWebSocketTask instances for testing.

methods.name: makeTestGatewayConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a GatewayConnection instance configured with the fake WebSocket session for testing.
